title: Connecting to a server via RDP stops text boxes being responsive while the server is the active tab
author: RyanNHS
body_snippet:
Using the latest nightly build. 

When opening an RDP session and the server is the active tab, you cannot edit any text boxes in the toolbars or connections pane as it redirects all input into the active RDP window. If you open a new connection tab not connected to a server or right-click the active connection and disconnect, you can once again use the text fields.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed for the next nightly.

**Cause:** while an RDP tab is the active connection, the embedded MSTSC ActiveX control keeps Win32 keyboard focus. Clicking a text box in the toolbar or the connections pane couldn't pull focus away from it, so your keystrokes went to the remote session. The existing focus-handoff only triggers when the whole window is (re)activated — e.g. Alt-Tabbing back in — not for a click *inside* the already-active window, which is why opening a non-server tab "fixed" it temp...
